reference_type: SPH and ABAQUS FEM numerical comparisons, not an analytical solution
material_tracking: Select fixed native IDs and bilinear weights from initial coordinates; reuse those IDs and weights at every saved time. Do not reselect nearest nodes in deformed geometry.

figure10.palette: Reuse the inspected original 12-band paper palette from lian_fig10_first3_r1.py

figure11.quantity: excess pore pressure at A and B
figure11.limitation: The unchanged .05-s save cadence does not resolve the paper .01-.05-s initial interval. Do not invent those samples.

figure12a.quantity: downward-positive material settlement z0-z at A and B

figure12b.horizontal_quantity: signed displacement x-x0, not its absolute value
figure12b.vertical_quantity: initial elevation z0 from bottom; also retain actual z and depth=10-z0
figure12b.paper_line_convention_limit: Paper does not explicitly define material versus current Eulerian line; this project uses the initial material line consistently with A/B histories.

reference_curves: Digitized SPH/FEM curves must have traceable paper/figure provenance; no fabricated reference table is supplied.
analysis_location: After full output copy-back, generate formal PNGs AND matching CSVs under case-root figures. The historical postprocess_lian_release.py is not the current HG+SPR release processor.
